scripts.dev:fresh: pnpm --filter @threenative/terrain --filter @threenative/core build && pnpm bake && node scripts/prep/prep-fab-temperate.mjs --auto && vite --force
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm bake && node scripts/prep/stage-native-assets.mjs && node ../../packages/runtime-native/scripts/bundle.mjs --project . --entry src/game.ts --target desktop --output dist/strata-terrain-native.js
scripts.test:terrain:web: pnpm build && node ../../packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js playtests/terrain.playtest.json --url 'http://127.0.0.1:5196/?showcase=1&waterproof=1' --server-command 'pnpm exec vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5196 --strictPort' --browser-recipe webgpu --headed --artifacts artifacts/playtest/web && node scripts/verify/verify-ocean.mjs artifacts/playtest/web --proof=water
scripts.test:terrain:web:control: pnpm build && node ../../packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js playtests/terrain.playtest.json --url 'http://127.0.0.1:5196/?showcase=1&waterproof=foam' --server-command 'pnpm exec vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5196 --strictPort' --browser-recipe webgpu --headed --artifacts artifacts/playtest/water-control && node scripts/verify/verify-ocean.mjs artifacts/playtest/water-control --proof=foam
scripts.test:terrain:desktop: pnpm build:desktop && node ../../packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js playtests/terrain.playtest.json --target desktop --executable ../../packages/runtime-native/build/tn-linux/mystral --host-arg run --host-arg dist/strata-terrain-native.js --artifacts artifacts/playtest/desktop && node scripts/verify/verify-ocean.mjs artifacts/playtest/desktop && sh ../../scripts/xvfb.sh ../../packages/runtime-native/build/tn-linux/mystral run dist/strata-terrain-native.js --headless --frames 300 --screenshot artifacts/playtest/desktop/terrain-300frames.png
scripts.test:terrain:export:desktop: node ../../packages/runtime-native/scripts/bundle.mjs --project . --entry src/render/exportConsumer.ts --target desktop --output dist/strata-export-native.js && node ../../packages/playtest/dist/runner/cli.js playtests/export.playtest.json --target desktop --executable ../../packages/runtime-native/build/tn-linux/mystral --host-arg run --host-arg dist/strata-export-native.js --artifacts artifacts/playtest/world-export-native
scripts.test: pnpm bake && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && pnpm test:water
